title: Smt. Mithilesh Gupta v. Consumer Grievances Redressel Forum At Commissionary & Ors
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Amreshwar Pratap Sahi, J.; Anil Kumar Agarwal, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; petitioner relegated to Clause 6.5
headnote: A writ challenging an electricity demand on the ground of an erroneously operating meter was disposed of without deciding the dispute. The consumer was left to Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. Respondent no. 2 was directed to examine the complaint and pass an appropriate order in accordance with law within two months of production of a certified copy.
facts: Smt. Mithilesh Gupta petitioned the Allahabad High Court disputing an electricity demand, alleging that her meter was operating erroneously and that incorrect bills were being raised. The Consumer Grievances Redressal Forum at the Commissionerate and others were respondents. Counsel for the electricity department submitted that Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 afforded a remedy before the competent authority. The Court did not examine the meter or the bills on merits.

holding_units.topic: billing and meter-accuracy dispute — Clause 6.5 remedy
holding_units.holding: Where a consumer disputes the correctness of an electricity demand on the ground that the meter is operating erroneously, Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is the available forum for redressal. The writ petition is disposed of with liberty to approach the competent authority (respondent no. 2), who shall examine the complaint and pass an appropriate order in accordance with law.

not_decided.point: Whether the meter was operating erroneously and whether the demand was incorrect
not_decided.note: Left to respondent no. 2 to examine the complaint and pass an appropriate order in accordance with law.
